description: Phase-36 RESEARCH-ONLY library mechanism extractors. Read ONLY by scripts/library_mechanism_extractors.py (un-wired). Adds source-backed mechanism-extraction DEPTH for the library/value-flow neighborhoods P35 surfaces: bytes/offset/packed decode mismatch, oracle value-derivation/staleness/decimals mismatch, accounting if-check/conditional state-update asymmetry. A candidate may only survive with EXACT source evidence + a downstream value-flow use + a comparand-grounded mismatch (support>=MEDIUM); else it ABSTAINS. Sibling-CALL-delta candidates additionally pass the P34 comparand_parity_gate. Vocab is GENERIC standard-DeFi only — NO subject-specific (e.g. dittoeth) names. is_gate:false research_only:true routes_in_production:false routed_manifest_ids:[].
_support_note: A SELF-CONTAINED mismatch (offset/field/branch) is a hypothesis until STRONG-confirmed (e.g. an encode-site offset comparand, or a computed term explicitly not applied). MEDIUM self-contained candidates are EMITTED for human review but ABSTAIN at the advance bar — branch/offset asymmetry alone is frequently intentional, and advancing it en masse would recreate the P33 noisy-advance class. Sibling-CALL-delta candidates advance only via the P34 comparand_parity_gate, independent of this threshold.
